pages.text: One might ask "How do I quickly empty a cell into a chest or drawer array or backpack, or, inversely, fill a cell from the same?"$(br2)The answer is use of an $(l:items_blocks_machines/io_port)ME IO Port$(/l) and some subnetting to restrict where it can put the items, or pull items from.$(br2)$(#555)$(o)(3D scene not available in this version)$()

pages.title: Configurations
pages.text: $(li)The $(l:items_blocks_machines/io_port)ME IO Port$(/l) (1) can be set to either "Transfer data to Network" or "Transfer data to Storage Cell" using the arrow button in the middle of the GUI. It has 3 acceleration cards for maximum speed.$(li)The $(l:items_blocks_machines/storage_bus)ME Storage Bus$(/l) (2) is in its default configuration.

pages.title: How It Works
pages.text: $(bold)In "Transfer To Network" Mode$()$(br2)1. The $(l:items_blocks_machines/io_port)ME IO Port$(/l) attempts to dump the contents of the inserted $(l:items_blocks_machines/storage_cells)storage cell$(/l). into $(l:ae2_mechanics/import_export_storage)network storage$(/l).$(br2)2. The only storage on the subnet is the $(l:items_blocks_machines/storage_bus)ME Storage Bus$(/l), which stores the items or fluids or etc. in whatever you put in front of it.$(li)The $(l:items_blocks_machines/energy_cells)Energy Cell$(/l) provides a large enough buffer of $(l:ae2_mechanics/energy)energy$(/l)

that the network does not run out from the power draw of transferring so many items per gametick.$(br2)$(bold)In "Transfer To Storage Cell" Mode$()$(br2)1. The $(l:items_blocks_machines/io_port)ME IO Port$(/l) attempts to dump the contents of the $(l:ae2_mechanics/import_export_storage)network's storage$(/l) into the inserted $(l:items_blocks_machines/storage_cells)storage cell$(/l).$(br2)2. The only storage on the subnet is the $(l:items_blocks_machines/storage_bus)ME Storage Bus$(/l), which pulls the items or fluids

or etc. out of whatever you put in front of it.$(li)The $(l:items_blocks_machines/energy_cells)Energy Cell$(/l) provides a large enough buffer of $(l:ae2_mechanics/energy)energy$(/l) that the network does not run out from the power draw of transferring so many items per gametick.
